newsitem.title: HAITI: Haiti police inspector doubles as hit man.
newsitem.headline: Haiti police inspector doubles as hit man.

text.p: A man dressed in a Carnival costume shot dead a businessman and then killed a policeman who chased him before he was gunned down himself, Haitian press reported on Monday.
When police pulled off the assassin's mask they discovered he was a local police inspector, Harold Pierre.

Pierre, wearing his disguise, shot Leonel Montalvo Lexis outside his home in Cayes on Haiti's south coast, HPA said. Police gave chase and fired teargas to force him out of a house where he tried to hide.
He opened fire on the police, killing one before he was shot.
Police said a business dispute appeared to be the motive for the shooting of Lexis.
